name: robocrypto
description: Simple 24/7 paper-trading dashboard for BTC/ETH/USDT-pairs on Binance, with swing/scalping/day-trade strategy switching, a local technical-analysis summary, and Telegram push - sibling project to robotrader.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js src/engine/*.js api/engine/*.js scripts/*.mjs public/app.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node -e "import('./src/engine/tick.js').then(() => import('./src/settings.js'))"
